findings.current: This was her own eve-of-battle ritual after losing countless companions during the Great Cataclysm.
findings.defect: Calling the drink a “ritual” implies an established or recurring observance, while 전야제 identifies it as her personal eve-of-battle celebration.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly uses 전야제(前夜祭), meaning an eve celebration or festivities, and does not establish that Pai Chen habitually performs this as a ritual.
findings.replacement: This was her own eve-of-battle celebration after losing countless companions during the Great Cataclysm.

summary: Faithful overall, with one minor change that turns a one-time eve-of-battle celebration into an implied recurring ritual.
